subject: maths
title: Cartesian Form and the Argand Diagram
welcome_lead: Step into the complex plane: add, multiply and visualize a + bi.
meta_desc: IBDP HL Maths adventure on cartesian form of complex numbers and Argand diagrams.
final_note: i^2 = -1 opens an entire plane of numbers!

concepts.def: z = a + bi with real a and imaginary b.
z̄ = a - bi, reflection across real axis.
arg(z) = θ with tan θ = b/a.
Plane with real and imaginary axes.

walkthroughs.body_html:
z = 3 + 2i, w = 1 - i. Find z + w and zw.

z + w = 4 + i. zw = 3 - 3i + 2i - 2i^2 = 5 - i.

z = 1 + √3 i. |z| = 2, arg = π/3.

Argand: point at (1, √3), distance 2 from origin.
